purpose: Verify the real two-process Dramatiq path when the worker parent has already selected fork.

attempts.symptom: The scheduler could not see the disposable database created inside the Docker PostgreSQL container.
attempts.cause: localhost:5432 resolved to a separate host PostgreSQL server in this environment.
attempts.replacement: Use a dedicated schema on the exact PostgreSQL endpoint used by Loreley.

attempts.postgres_isolation: dedicated schema on the application endpoint

conclusion: A fork-initialized parent was replaced with spawn for the real Dramatiq pool; both workers used distinct base clones and workspaces, completed every job exactly once, and preserved fair island allocation.
